I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-random. I confirmed that the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats and that I'll use that number instead of the one from this morning. They said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else.

I also didn't repeat or link to their earlier #north-team post in #north-random, because the two channels may have different members. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so posting the corrected 100 in the reply was fine.
